nodes.label: What is the best gas loyalty points card in Canada?
nodes.description: Identify the most beneficial gas loyalty points card in Canada based on key evaluation criteria.

nodes.label: How much can you earn in points or rewards?
nodes.description: Evaluate the earning potential of each card based on spending habits and points per litre or dollar.

nodes.label: What are the redemption options and flexibility?
nodes.description: Assess the variety and value of rewards available for points earned.

nodes.label: What are the financial and usage costs?
nodes.description: Analyze the cost of using the card, including annual fees, foreign transaction fees, and credit requirements.

nodes.label: How accessible and convenient is the program?
nodes.description: Evaluate the ease of use, including gas station coverage, mobile app quality, and expiration policies.

nodes.label: points earn rate
nodes.description: The rate at which points or rewards are earned per litre or dollar spent.

nodes.label: redemption flexibility
nodes.description: The variety and value of rewards available for points.

nodes.label: annual fee
nodes.description: The cost of maintaining the card per year.

nodes.label: gas station partner coverage
nodes.description: The number and geographic spread of gas stations where the card can be used.

nodes.label: sign-up bonus
nodes.description: The initial reward or points offered for signing up.

nodes.label: expiration policy
nodes.description: How long points remain valid before expiring.

nodes.label: mobile app quality
nodes.description: The usability and features of the program's mobile app.

nodes.label: extra perks
nodes.description: Additional benefits such as car washes, gift certificates, or other rewards.

nodes.label: foreign transaction fee
nodes.description: The fee charged for using the card outside of Canada.

nodes.label: credit requirements
nodes.description: The credit score or financial background needed to qualify for the card.
